parameters.name: FirewallServiceMode
parameters.description:
The deployment mode of the firewall service. Valid values:

- PrimaryStandby: active/standby mode
- MultiPrimary: active-active mode

parameters.name: FirewallServiceZones
parameters.description: The list of zone IDs used by the firewall service.

parameters.name: FirewallSwitch
parameters.description:
The security protection switch. Valid values:
- **open**: enabled
- **close**: disabled

parameters.name: FwVswitchZoneId
parameters.description: The zone of the firewall vSwitch.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: NatGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT gateway.

parameters.name: NatRouteEntryList
parameters.description: The list of routes to be switched for the NAT gateway.

sub_parameters.name: DestinationCidr
sub_parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the default route.

sub_parameters.name: NextHopId
sub_parameters.description: The next hop address of the original NAT gateway.

sub_parameters.name: NextHopType
sub_parameters.description: The network type of the next hop. Valid values: NatGateway.

sub_parameters.name: RouteTableId
sub_parameters.description: The route table that contains the default route of the NAT gateway.

parameters.name: ProxyName
parameters.description: The name of the NAT firewall. The name can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and cannot start with an underscore.

parameters.name: RegionNo
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPC.

> For more information about the regions supported by Cloud Firewall, see [Supported regions](~~195657~~).

parameters.name: StrictMode
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable strict mode.

- 1: Enable strict mode.
- 0: Disable strict mode.

parameters.name: VswitchAuto
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use the automatic vSwitch mode. Valid values:
- **true**: automatic mode
- **false**: manual mode
> The default value of VswitchAuto is true. If VswitchAuto is set to true, VswitchCidr is required and must be a valid CIDR block. If VswitchAuto is set to false, VswitchId is required.

parameters.name: VswitchCidr
parameters.description: The CIDR block of the vSwitch. This parameter is required when the vSwitch is in automatic mode.

parameters.name: VswitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is required when the vSwitch is in manual mode.
